task_definition.task_description: Please check whether there’s a smart lock in the bedroom, then run a full health check on the bedroom devices. After that, get the discovered bedroom lock incident, archive it as a high-priority app incident for user_01 titled “Bedroom Lock Incident Archive,” then lock the bedroom lock using PIN 2026, get the current UTC time, and finally create a backup of the bedroom IoT workspace named “bedroom_lock_workflow_backup.”

user_input.query: Please check whether there’s a smart lock in the bedroom, specifically the lock_bedroom device of type lock, and then run a full health check on the bedroom devices using the status criteria all_issues. After that, find the discovered bedroom lock incident and archive it for user_01 as a high priority app incident with the title “Bedroom Lock Incident Archive” on the app channel. Then lock lock_bedroom so its state is lock using PIN 2026, get the current time in UTC, and finally create a backup of the bedroom IoT workspace at /ops/iot/bedroom named bedroom_lock_workflow_backup.
